issues.description: Return type annotation for simulate_msd_one_round differs between the problem statement and the template. The problem statement (and the intended behavior described in the docstring) specifies simulate_msd_one_round(n_shots: int, p: float) -> tuple[float, float] (error rate, acceptance rate). However, the template defines simulate_msd_one_round with a return annotation of list[float]. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and may cause them to implement or test the function incorrectly (e.g., expecting a tuple versus a list). The solution implements the function returning a tuple[float, float], matching the problem statement, which shows the template annotation is inconsistent with the intended API.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the return type annotation in the template for simulate_msd_one_round to match the problem statement: def simulate_msd_one_round(n_shots: int, p: float) -> tuple[float, float]:. Ensure the docstring and any callers in the template use the same tuple convention (error_rate, acceptance_rate).
